nodes.long_description: Ξεκινήστε την περιπέτειά σας σήμερα! Καθίστε στη θέση του οδηγού και εξερευνήστε έναν κόσμο όπου οι δεινόσαυροι κυκλοφορούν ελεύθεροι. Χαρακτηριστικά: Πραγματική οδήγηση VR και χαλαρωτική εξερεύνηση.
nodes.short_description: Κάντε μια άγρια βόλτα στον κόσμο των δεινοσαύρων! Οδηγήστε ένα τζιπ σαφάρι σε μια πανέμορφη γη γεμάτη γιγάντιους δεινόσαυρους στο VR.

nodes.long_description: Начните свое приключение уже сегодня! Сядьте за руль сафари-джипа и исследуйте мир динозавров. Особенности: реалистичное вождение в VR и красивые локации с вулканом.
nodes.short_description: Отправьтесь в дикое путешествие в мир динозавров! Управляйте джипом сафари в VR и исследуйте земли, населенные гигантами.

nodes.long_description: Začněte své dinosauří dobrodružství ještě dnes! Sedněte si za volant safari džípu a prozkoumejte svět, kde stále žijí dinosauři. Vlastnosti: Skutečné VR řízení a relaxační průzkum.
nodes.short_description: Vydejte se na divokou jízdu do světa dinosaurů! Projíždějte v safari džípu krásnou krajinou plnou obřích dinosaurů a divokých zvířat ve VR.

nodes.long_description: Commencez votre aventure aujourd'hui ! Installez-vous au volant d'une jeep et explorez un monde où les dinosaures règnent encore. Caractéristiques : Pilotage VR réaliste et décors époustouflants.
nodes.short_description: Partez pour une virée sauvage au pays des dinosaures ! Conduisez une jeep safari à travers des terres magnifiques peuplées de géants en VR.

nodes.long_description: Start Your Wild Dinosaur Adventure Today! Features: Real VR driving mechanics, amazing prehistoric creatures to encounter, and a vast world to explore at your own pace.
nodes.short_description: Take a wild ride into the world of dinosaurs! Drive a safari jeep through a beautiful land filled with giant dinosaurs and wild animals in full VR.

nodes.long_description: 今天就開始您的恐龍探險！坐在野生動物園吉普車的駕駛座上，探索一個恐龍橫行的世界。遊戲特色：真實VR駕駛體驗、近距離接觸巨型恐龍以及輕鬆的探索模式。
nodes.short_description: 開啟恐龍世界的狂野之旅！在VR中駕駛越野吉普車穿過充滿巨型恐龍和野生動物的美麗土地。

nodes.long_description: Start dit vilde dinosaureventyr i dag! Sæt dig i førersædet på en safari-jeep og udforsk en stor verden. Funktioner: Rigtig VR-kørsel, mød fantastiske væsner og slap af i naturen.
nodes.short_description: Tag på en vild tur ind i dinosaurernes verden! Kør i en safari-jeep gennem et smukt land fyldt med kæmpe dinosaurer og vilde dyr i VR.

nodes.long_description:
Embark on an unforgettable virtual reality expedition in Safari World VR Adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes filled with exotic wildlife, dense jungles, and mysterious prehistoric creatures. Every journey offers new discoveries as you travel through immersive environments, observe animals in their natural habitats, and experience the excitement of a true safari adventure.

Meet a wide variety of wild animals and come face to face with towering dinosaurs that bring the ancient world to life. Wander through lush forests, hidden trails, and scenic locations while uncovering surprises around every corner. Whether you're exploring for fun or learning about fascinating creatures, every adventure feels unique and rewarding.

Features:
• Explore immersive safari environments in VR.
• Discover wildlife from around the world.
• Encounter realistic dinosaurs and prehistoric creatures.
• Travel through dense jungles and hidden paths.
• Interactive exploration with smooth VR controls.
• Beautiful landscapes with detailed environments.
• Exciting adventures filled with surprises.
• Relaxing gameplay suitable for all ages.
• Enjoy realistic sounds and immersive atmosphere.
• Experience endless exploration and discovery.

Safari World VR Adventure combines exploration, wildlife encounters, and prehistoric excitement into one immersive VR experience. Walk beside majestic animals, admire breathtaking scenery, uncover hidden secrets, and create unforgettable memories.
nodes.short_description: Step into the wild with Safari World VR Adventure and experience an unforgettable journey through stunning natural environments. Encounter incredible wildlife, explore dense jungles, discover ancient dinosaurs, and interact with amazing creatures in immersive virtual reality. Complete exciting adventures, uncover hidden locations, and enjoy a realistic safari experience designed for explorers of all ages.

nodes.long_description: Começa a tua aventura hoje mesmo! Senta-te no banco do condutor e explora um mundo vasto com dinossauros. Características: Condução VR realista e exploração relaxante.
nodes.short_description: Embarca numa jornada selvagem pelo mundo dos dinossauros! Conduz um jipe de safari por terras repletas de gigantes pré-históricos em VR.

nodes.long_description: Start ditt ville dinosaureventyr i dag! Sett deg bak rattet i en safari-jeep og utforsk en verden full av kjemper. Funksjoner: Ekte VR-kjøring og avslappende omgivelser.
nodes.short_description: Ta en vill tur inn i dinosaurenes verden! Kjør en safari-jeep gjennom et vakkert land fylt med gigantiske dinosaurer og ville dyr i VR.

nodes.long_description: ¡Comienza tu aventura hoy mismo! Ponte al volante de un jeep de safari y explora un mundo donde los dinosaurios aún viven. Recursos: Conducción VR real y exploración relajante.
nodes.short_description: ¡Vive un viaje salvaje al mundo de los dinosaurios! Conduce un jeep de safari por una tierra hermosa llena de gigantes y animales en VR.

nodes.long_description: ¡Comienza tu aventura hoy mismo! Ponte al volante de un jeep de safari y explora un mundo donde los dinosaurios aún viven. Características: Conducción realista y paisajes increíbles.
nodes.short_description: ¡Vive un viaje salvaje al mundo de los dinosaurios! Conduce un jeep de safari por una tierra hermosa llena de gigantes y animales en VR.

nodes.long_description: Starta ditt vilda dinosaurieäventyr idag! Sätt dig bakom ratten på en safarijeep och utforska en stor värld. Innehåller: Riktig VR-körning och avslappnande miljöer.
nodes.short_description: Ta en vild tur in i dinosauriernas värld! Kör en safarijeep genom ett vackert land fyllt med gigantiska dinosaurier och vilda djur i VR.

nodes.long_description: Începe-ți aventura cu dinozauri astăzi! Urcă-te la volanul unui jeep și explorează o lume unde uriașii încă trăiesc. Caracteristici: Condus VR realist și explorare relaxantă.
nodes.short_description: Fă o plimbare sălbatică în lumea dinozaurilor! Conduce un jeep de safari printr-un ținut minunat, plin de dinozauri uriași în VR.

nodes.long_description: Comece sua aventura hoje mesmo! Sente-se no banco do motorista e explore um mundo vasto com dinossauros. Recursos: Direção VR realista, animais incríveis e exploração relaxante.
nodes.short_description: Embarque em uma jornada selvagem pelo mundo dos dinossauros! Dirija um jipe de safári por terras repletas de gigantes pré-históricos em VR.

nodes.long_description: Inizia oggi la tua avventura con i dinosauri! Mettiti alla guida di una jeep ed esplora un mondo dove i giganti esistono ancora. Caratteristiche: Guida VR realistica e ambienti mozzafiato.
nodes.short_description: Fai un viaggio selvaggio nel mondo dei dinosauri! Guida una jeep safari attraverso terre meravigliose piene di giganti preistorici in VR.

nodes.long_description: Starten Sie heute Ihr Dinosaurier-Abenteuer! Setzen Sie sich ans Steuer eines Jeeps und erkunden Sie eine Welt voller Giganten. Features: Echtes VR-Fahren und eine entspannte Atmosphäre.
nodes.short_description: Machen Sie eine wilde Fahrt in die Welt der Dinosaurier! Fahren Sie mit einem Safari-Jeep durch ein wunderschönes Land voller Urzeitriesen in VR.

nodes.long_description: 今天就開始您的恐龍探險！坐在野生動物園吉普車的駕駛座上，探索一個恐龍橫行的世界。遊戲特色：真實VR駕駛體驗、近距離接觸巨型恐龍以及輕鬆的探索模式。
nodes.short_description: 開啟恐龍世界的狂野之旅！在VR中駕駛越野吉普車穿過充滿巨型恐龍和野生動物的美麗土地。

nodes.long_description: Bắt đầu cuộc phiêu lưu của bạn ngay hôm nay! Ngồi vào ghế lái xe jeep và khám phá thế giới nơi khủng long vẫn còn tồn tại. Đặc điểm: Lái xe VR chân thực và khám phá thư giãn.
nodes.short_description: Thực hiện một chuyến đi hoang dã vào thế giới khủng long! Lái xe jeep safari qua vùng đất tuyệt đẹp với những loài khủng long khổng lồ trong VR.

nodes.long_description: 오늘 바로 공룡 어드벤처를 시작하세요! 지프 운전석에 앉아 공룡이 살아 숨 쉬는 세계를 탐험하세요. 특징: 실제와 같은 VR 운전, 거대한 공룡과의 만남, 스트레스 없는 힐링 모험.
nodes.short_description: 공룡의 세계로 야생의 여행을 떠나보세요! VR에서 사파리 지프를 운전하며 거대한 공룡과 야생 동물이 가득한 아름다운 땅을 탐험하세요.

nodes.long_description: Begin vandaag nog aan je wilde dinosaurusavontuur! Kruip achter het stuur van een safari-jeep en ontdek een wereld vol reuzen. Kenmerken: Echt VR-rijden en een ontspannen sfeer.
nodes.short_description: Maak een wilde rit door de wereld van de dinosauriërs! Bestuur een safari-jeep door een prachtig land vol reusachtige dino's en wilde dieren in VR.

nodes.long_description: Aloita villi dinosaurusseikkailusi tänään! Hyppää safari-jeepin rattiin ja tutki suurta maailmaa. Ominaisuudet: Aito VR-ajo, upeat dinosaurukset ja rentouttava tutkimusmatka.
nodes.short_description: Lähde villille matkalle dinosaurusten maailmaan! Aja safari-jeepillä läpi kauniin maan, joka on täynnä jättiläisdinosauruksia ja villieläimiä VR:ssä.

nodes.long_description: Dinozor maceranıza bugün başlayın! Bir safari cipinin sürücü koltuğuna oturun ve devlerin dünyasını keşfedin. Özellikler: Gerçek VR sürüşü ve rahatlatıcı keşif modları.
nodes.short_description: Dinozorların dünyasına vahşi bir yolculuğa çıkın! VR'da dev dinozorlar ve vahşi hayvanlarla dolu güzel bir arazide safari cipi sürün.

nodes.long_description: Zacznij swoją przygodę już dziś! Usiądź za kierownicą dżipa safari i odkryj świat, w którym wciąż żyją dinozaury. Cechy: Realistyczne prowadzenie pojazdu VR i niesamowite widoki.
nodes.short_description: Wybierz się na szaloną przejażdżkę do świata dinozaurów! Prowadź dżip safari przez piękną krainę pełną gigantycznych gadów w VR.

nodes.long_description: 今天就开始您的恐龙探险！坐在野生动物园吉普车的驾驶座上，探索一个恐龙横行的世界。游戏特色：真实VR驾驶体验、近距离接触巨型恐龙以及轻松的探索模式。
nodes.short_description: 开启恐龙世界的狂野之旅！在VR中驾驶越野吉普车穿过充满巨型恐龙和野生动物的美丽土地。

nodes.long_description: 恐竜アドベンチャーを今すぐ体験！サファリジープの運転席に座り、恐竜たちが歩き回る広大な世界へ。特徴：リアルなVR運転操作、巨大な恐竜との遭遇、そしてリラックスできる探索。
nodes.short_description: 恐竜の世界へワイルドな旅に出かけよう！VRでサファリジープを運転し、巨大な恐竜や野生動物たちが暮らす美しい大地を探索。

nodes.long_description:
Start Your Wild Dinosaur Adventure Today!

Get ready for a fun and exciting journey with Safari World VR Adventure. Put yourself in the driver’s seat of a safari jeep and explore a big world where dinosaurs still roam. From the long-necked giants to the fast hunters, you will see them all up close in your headset.

Why You Will Love It:
Real VR Driving: Use your controllers to steer your safari jeep. It feels like you are actually driving through the wild forest and plains.

See Amazing Dinosaurs: Drive past different kinds of dinosaurs and animals. Watch them walk and move in their natural world.

Big World to Explore: Drive through different areas like green forests and rocky mountains with a giant volcano in the back.

Easy and Relaxing: No timers or stress. Just enjoy the view, take in the sights, and explore the dinosaur world at your own pace.

Great Visuals: Enjoy a bright and colorful 3D world that looks great on Meta Quest.

Whether you love dinosaurs or just want a cool place to drive, Safari World VR Adventure is the perfect adventure. Put on your headset, start the engine, and go on a safari today!
nodes.short_description: Take a wild ride into the world of dinosaurs! In Safari World VR Adventure, you drive a safari jeep through a beautiful land filled with giant dinosaurs and wild animals. Experience the thrill of being close to these amazing creatures in full VR. It’s a fun and relaxing adventure for everyone!

nodes.short_description: Thực hiện một chuyến đi hoang dã vào thế giới khủng long! Lái xe jeep safari qua vùng đất tuyệt đẹp với những loài khủng long khổng lồ trong VR.

nodes.long_description: Começa a tua aventura hoje mesmo! Senta-te no banco do condutor e explora um mundo vasto com dinossauros. Características: Condução VR realista e exploração relaxante.
nodes.short_description: Embarca numa jornada selvagem pelo mundo dos dinossauros! Conduz um jipe de safari por terras repletas de gigantes pré-históricos em VR.

nodes.long_description: Start Your Wild Dinosaur Adventure Today! Features: Real VR driving mechanics, amazing prehistoric creatures to encounter, and a vast world to explore at your own pace.
nodes.short_description: Take a wild ride into the world of dinosaurs! Drive a safari jeep through a beautiful land filled with giant dinosaurs and wild animals in full VR.

nodes.long_description: Începe-ți aventura cu dinozauri astăzi! Urcă-te la volanul unui jeep și explorează o lume unde uriașii încă trăiesc. Caracteristici: Condus VR realist și explorare relaxantă.
nodes.short_description: Fă o plimbare sălbatică în lumea dinozaurilor! Conduce un jeep de safari printr-un ținut minunat, plin de dinozauri uriași în VR.
